notes: Fake Your Own Death, printed: 'Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control and you create a Treasure token."' Seat 0 targets its own 2/2: it is 4/2 (2 damage kills it). Seat 1's Pinger deals it 2 damage the same turn: it dies, then returns to the battlefield TAPPED under its owner's (seat 0's) control as a new object (a plain 2/2: no +2/+0, no damage, no granted ability) and seat 0 creates one Treasure token. A second creature that was not targeted dies the same turn from 2 damage and stays in the graveyard, with no second Treasure.
